title: Germ Warfare: The Flavor of Living Weapon

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Biomechanical invaders who grow embryos in vats and compleat them into machine-warriors, and who are now conquering Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The inhabitants of Mirrodin, fighting a war against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane where the war between Phyrexians and Mirrans is fought.

entities.name: Germs
entities.description: Vat-grown embryonic Phyrexians taken before maturing, which pilot living weapons.

entities.name: Flayer Husk
entities.description: A living weapon: a clawed hand that scrabbles on its fingertips until fused onto a Phyrexian's wrist.

entities.name: Strandwalker
entities.description: A living weapon: a set of jointed, spiderlike, necromechanical legs.

entities.name: Skinwing
entities.description: A living weapon: a metal framework stretched with wings of ragged skin.

entities.name: Bonehoard
entities.description: A living weapon of ligament, bone and metal that roves Mirrodin harvesting calcium.

entities.name: Mortarpod
entities.description: A living weapon: a walking metal tube attached to a furnace-orb that launches part of its host.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A character with more to come later in the block, whose Keepers are green.

entities.name: the Tangle
entities.description: A green-aligned region of Mirrodin whose creatures fell readily to Phyrexian influence.

events.summary: Living weapons are introduced as autonomous Phyrexian body parts that can live on their own, driven by germs.
events.quote: The living weapons are autonomous Phyrexian body parts.

events.summary: Phyrexia has spread unevenly across the colors, with black and green falling quickly and red showing the most resistance.
events.quote: Red mana, though, has shown the most resistance.

relations.quote: The living weapon artifacts are an ingenious new development in the war between the Phyrexians and the Mirrans.
